name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.326.0 — The file decides, not the tier — a gate failure in a file outside the File Plan is triaged by out-of-plan-triage.js (spec-paths out-of-plan-triage): only a § Risk Tiers path surface or orchestratorOnly path asks; every other file is added to scope with an [auto: out-of-plan-triage] Decisions row the reviewer re-derives. 7.325.0 — Tests that earn their keep: [oracle: literals] retires wording at review with no test left behind (ac-matrix evaluates it against the File Plan's non-tests files); prose is pinned for references and protocol tokens only; expiry judges each test case by its reach (lib/case-reach.js) and treats bin/ launchers as invariant roots. 7.324.0 — a fan-out lane's exit survives the sidecar delete its own step prints: the exit is also recorded beside the lane's delegation marker, and the fan-out reads it there first (q28).
